grade_rule: grade = 0 if C <= threshold else 1, then panel-scale mapping; here every beer is below threshold so grade = 0
caveat: This is a threshold-anchored inference, not a measured panel score. It answers the 0-6 request only in the degenerate sense that the whole dataset is below the sensory detection threshold, so every beer takes the 0 = Not present level. The paper reports it separately from the 50-panel columns and states that no per-taster 0-6 acetaldehyde record exists in any released file.
